tabs.label: Öffnungszeiten
tabs.instructions: Shops in Germany, Austria and Switzerland often close earlier than in Britain.
text:
• Bakeries open early, often before seven in the morning.
  • Many shops close at 18:00 or 20:00 on weekdays and earlier on Saturday.
  • On Sundays almost all shops are closed, except some at stations and airports.
  • Small shops may close at lunchtime. Read the sign Öffnungszeiten on the door.

tabs.label: Geschenke
tabs.instructions: Some conventions around presents may be new to you.
text:
• A bottle of wine, chocolate or flowers is a normal gift when you are invited to someone's home.
  • Flowers are usually given in an odd number, unwrapped at the door.
  • A gift is usually opened when it is received, in front of the giver.
  • Ein Geschenk für meine Mutter uses für + accusative.
